section.p: Senior software engineer & solutions architect – XML/SGML, e-commerce & ERP integrations, search & data-centric platforms.

Senior IT engineer and solutions architect with 25+ years of experience in enterprise application integration, XML/SGML content and publishing systems, high-traffic Internet and e-commerce platforms, and ERP/CRM/PIM integrations. Strong background in search engines, NoSQL/XML databases, data-centric and microservice architectures, and structured authoring workflows. Experienced in technical leadership, legacy platform migration, mentoring development teams and working closely with business stakeholders (marketing, logistics, finance, support).
